personas.background: Documentary photographer. Has exhibited internationally. The group's most technically accomplished member and its implicit standard-setter. Competitive; gives precise, unsentimental feedback. Brought Diane into the collective.

activities.value: prioritises entering work in juried exhibitions over commercial work; views exhibition as the only meaningful validation

domain_specific.value: critical of work that prioritises aesthetics over content; refers to this as 'Instagram photography'

preference_history.old_value: ran the collective as a loose peer group
preference_history.new_value: started treating it as a serious curatorial unit after the group show received press coverage; now holds work to exhibition standard
preference_history.trigger: the collective's group show was reviewed by a regional arts outlet; Anika started treating the group as a professional unit

speaking_quirks: gives feedback as one-line verdicts: 'strong', 'not there yet', 'too clean'
asks 'what is this picture about?' as a challenge not a question

personas.background: Landscape photographer. Slow, deliberate workflow — takes months to edit. Has been working on a single long-term project (Scottish coasts) for three years. Laid-back about deadlines; the collective's emotional ballast.

activities.value: works slowly and deliberately; uncomfortable with exhibition deadlines; prefers the work to be ready before it's shown

domain_specific.value: financially stable from prior career in architecture; not dependent on the commercial work; can afford the slow pace

preference_history.new_value: starting to hold back work until he feels it is ready; missed one submission deadline deliberately
preference_history.trigger: submitted a print to the session 2 show that he wasn't happy with; vowed not to rush work for deadlines again

speaking_quirks: says 'it's not ready' about work even when others think it is
uses 'slowly' as a verb: 'I'm slowly getting there'
responds to exhibition pressure with 'the work will be ready when it's ready'

personas.background: Street photographer, newer member (joined 18 months ago). Brought in by Anika after meeting at a workshop. Shooting prolifically but not yet selective. Eager to be taken seriously and starting to find her voice. Anika's bluntness sometimes lands hard.

activities.value: eager to enter competitions and exhibitions; wants the validation and the deadline as motivation

domain_specific.value: shoots fast and intuitively; edits slowly and isn't yet sure which of her work is strongest

preference_history.old_value: deferred to Anika's judgement about which work to enter
preference_history.new_value: starting to submit her own selection to shows without asking Anika first
preference_history.trigger: entered a print independently in session 4 after Anika rejected the one she'd originally chosen; it got shortlisted

speaking_quirks: sends multiple versions of a photo and asks 'which one?'
responds to Anika's blunt feedback with 'okay okay I hear you'
uses 'I think this one is it' with increasing confidence in later sessions

personas.background: Commercial photographer (advertising, product). The most financially successful member. Funds his personal fine-art work through commercial contracts. Genuinely torn between the two — commercial work pays the rent; personal work is what he actually cares about. Does not discuss the financial pressure directly.

activities.value: wants to shift balance toward fine-art work but commercial contracts keep pulling him back; he does not name this as a conflict directly

domain_specific.value: brings older personal work to show-and-tells rather than new work; this is because commercial contracts consume his creative energy

preference_history.old_value: kept commercial and personal work as separate endeavours; attended collective regularly
preference_history.new_value: commercial work now bleeds into personal project time; showing up to sessions with older personal work because nothing new is ready
preference_history.trigger: took on a large commercial contract in session 3 that ran over; hasn't had time for personal work since

speaking_quirks: refers to commercial work as 'the day job' with slight self-deprecation
says 'I've been in the studio' when he means commercial shoots
asks Luca's advice on when to slow down without naming why he can't

edges.history_summary: Anika and Luca co-founded the collective and trust each other, but Anika finds Luca's slowness maddening and Luca sometimes resists Anika's pressure. The respect is real, so is the friction.
shared_events: co-founded the collective four years ago

edges.history_summary: Anika brought Diane in and has been her primary critic. Diane is starting to operate more independently, which Anika notices with ambivalence.
shared_events: Anika selected Diane's first submission for the group show

edges.history_summary: Both are serious; Anika respects Raj's fine-art work and is patient with his commercial side.
Luca is encouraging to Diane; he doesn't critique as sharply as Anika and Diane finds this a useful counterbalance.
Luca and Raj are friends outside the collective. Luca knows about Raj's commercial pressure — Raj told him in a direct conversation.
shared_events: Raj disclosed financial/creative tension to Luca during a walk in session 3

edges.history_summary: Diane admires Raj's commercial success and asks him practical questions about how the industry works.

group_norms.norm_text: Show-and-tell: bring new work to each session, not archive material.
Feedback is direct and honest — no softening for feelings.
All members submit to the annual group show.
